# Settings Apply

A plugin cannot set most Claude Code settings, so `claudetto` ships a settings snippet.
This page shows how to put the [snippet](Settings-Snippet) into your settings file.
The easy way is `/claudetto:setup`.

## Apply the Snippet with Setup

1. Run `/claudetto:setup`.
2. Pick the scope: `user`, `project`, or `local`.
3. Read the list of changes, and approve the write.
4. Restart Claude Code.

The skill first runs `claudetto-setup --scope <scope>` as a preview.
Without `--apply`, the command writes nothing.
After you approve, the skill runs it again with `--apply`.

- A failed read of the settings file writes nothing.
- A second run changes nothing.
- The command makes no backup, so the list of changes is the record.
- When `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is set, the `user` scope uses that folder instead of `~/.claude`.

## What the Merge Does

| Kind of value | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Object | Merges key by key |
| Array | Adds the entries it lacks and keeps yours |
| Scalar | Takes the value of the snippet |
| Key the snippet does not name | Stays as it is |

The preview prints one line for each changed key path, as `path: old -> new`.
When nothing differs, it prints `Settings match the snippet.`

## Status Lines

The status line commands get the absolute path of the plugin folder.
That path holds the plugin version, so run setup again after each plugin update.
The `project` scope gets no status line, because the path belongs to one computer.
Use the `user` or `local` scope for it.
A status line of another tool stays, and the preview says so.

## The `.gitignore` Lines

With `--apply`, in a project that has `.git/`, setup appends these lines to `.gitignore` under a comment header:

```text
/.claudetto/
/.jscpd.json
/.claude/settings.local.json
```

It adds no line the file already has, and it changes nothing in a project with no `.git/`.

## Other Steps of Setup

- Setup removes two deny rules of 0.3.0-alpha.1, and keeps your keys ([Setup Cleanup](Setup-Cleanup)).
- Setup writes the subagent cap of your plan into `env` ([Setup](Setup#subagent-cap)).
- Setup names the Context7 skill or rule files that it finds in `~/.claude` or in the project.
- Setup gives an alias line for your shell that starts Claude Code with `Glob` and `Grep`.
  It does not edit your shell startup file.
- When `claudetto-docs` is installed, merge the [lines for the add-on](Settings-Snippet-Docs) by hand.

## Copy It by Hand

1. Copy the keys you want into `~/.claude/settings.json` (user scope).
2. Replace `<plugin folder>` in `statusLine` and `subagentStatusLine` with the absolute path of the plugin folder, or delete both keys.
   A status line command gets no `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}`, so the path must be absolute.
   Change both commands again after each plugin update.
3. Delete the `$schema` key, or keep it for the editor.
4. Restart Claude Code.

A test fails when the block holds a key of the [never-set list](Off-Switches-Never-Set).
